verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents an official tutorial for launching a robot simulation with Gazebo, and a long-time user lists sim among the ecosystem features you get 'for free'. The simulation itself is delivered through the separate Gazebo simulator rather than ROS 2 core, and the evidence never describes physics fidelity or sensor models. Missing for 10: evidence of realistic physics engines, simulated sensor models (e.g. lidar/camera/IMU), environment/world modeling details, and hands-on corroboration of sim-to-hardware workflows.
